name: bug
description: A patch fails, or a patched app does not work as described

name: app version
description: Morphe Manager does not accept an app version or build

name: enhancement
description: A request to improve a working patch, or for a new app or patch

name: question
description: A question or an idea

name: documentation
description: The README, the docs, or the issue forms

name: app update
description: The update check found a newer app version

name: incomplete
description: Missing required details; closes after 7 days without an update

name: untargeted version
description: The app version or build is not supported; closes after 7 days without an update

name: dev pre-release
description: Reported on a dev pre-release of the patches

name: needs review
description: The new app version needs a manual check or a patch change

name: ready to bump
description: Every patch applies to the new app version

name: confirmed
description: Reproduced, and the patches cause it

name: planned
description: Accepted, and planned for a future release

name: in development
description: Being worked on now

name: testing on dev
description: In a dev pre-release; comment with how it works on your device

name: released
description: Fixed or added in a main release

name: waiting for reporter
description: Waiting for an answer from the person who opened the issue

name: may reopen
description: Closed for now; reopened if new details come in within 7 days

name: upstream
description: Caused by the app, Morphe Manager, or another tool, not by the patches

name: not patchable
description: The app blocks patched copies, for example with Play Integrity or App Check

name: out of scope
description: Outside what the project does, such as paywalls, paid content, or posts not about these patches

name: duplicate
description: Another issue already covers this

name: wontfix
description: This will not be changed

name: dependencies
description: Pull requests that update a dependency file

name: github_actions
description: Pull requests that update GitHub Actions code

name: javascript
description: Pull requests that update javascript code

name: java
description: Pull requests that update java code
